subject: Mathematics

show.line: This is a heart. Two bumps on top and a point at the bottom. Good food keeps your heart strong!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Heart!
Which fruit looks like a heart?
rounds.praise: Yes! A strawberry looks like a heart.

rounds.prompt: Put the hearts in one group and the circles in the other.

hints: A heart has two round bumps on top.
Look for the point at the bottom.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the heart shape.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This orange slice is a heart!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The orange slice is a circle. A heart has a point.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A heart has two bumps and a point.

parent_line: Can recognise and name a heart shape.
